title: Executive Order No. 15, s. 2023
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

EXECUTIVE ORDER NO.15

RENAMING THE PRESIDENTIAL COMPLAINT CENTER AS THE
PRESIDENTIAL ACTION CENTER

WHEREAS, Executive Order (EO) No. 442 (s. 1991) established the
Presidential Complaints and Action Office (PCAO) in the Office of the President (OP)
to serve as the command center and liaison unit of the OP with various agencies on
all requests for assistance, complaints, and grievances from the general public;

WHEREAS, EO No. 447 (s. 1991) renamed the PCAO as the Presidential
Action Center (PACe);

WHEREAS, EO No. 09 (s. 2016) further renamed the PACe as the Presidential
Complaint Center (PCC), and placed it under the direct control and supervision of the
Strategic Action and Response (STAR) Office under the Office of the Cabinet
Secretary (OCS);

WHEREAS, under EO No. 09, the PCC shall establish and maintain a platform
to receive requests, complaints, and grievances from the general public, and refer
them to concerned government agencies;

WHEREAS, EO No. 67 (s. 2018) transferred the control and supervision of the
STAR Office from the OCS to the Office of the Executive Secretary;

WHEREAS, in addition to coordination and liaison work, the nature and scope
of the work of the PCC also includes providing public assistance and social services,
such as addressing complaints against government processes and various requests
for assistance; and

WHEREAS, there is a need to rename the PCC to ensure that its name is
consistent with the nature and scope of its work;

NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND R. MARCOS, JR., President of the

Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing laws,
do hereby order:

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
 
Section 1. Renaming. The Presidential Complaint Center is hereby renamed
as the Presidential Action Center.

Section 2. Repeal. EO No. 09 (s. 2016) is hereby amended insofar as it is
inconsistent with this Order. All orders, rules, regulations, and issuances or parts
thereof, which are inconsistent with this Order, are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

Section 3. Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this 8th dayof February , inthe
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Three.

 

By the President:
